
cdrom/cd-2x-burned
A CD-R read at single and double speed from the hub to the edge, a speed change mid-read, seeks at double speed.
Needs the double-speed disc (or the games disc). Cycles at the system clock (1 ms = 33,869). No assertions.

drive region: for U/C - unlocking
disc: lead-out at LBA 323850 (72:00), 00:02:16 marked D16
the double-speed disc: 10 places, 00:02:16 to 70:00:00
